deals.notes: The 2011-12-01 425 header lists SUBJECT COMPANY CIK 861185 and FILED BY CIK 885601; in the 425 text the filer is called Invesco Insured Municipal Income Trust and the subject Invesco Insured Municipal Bond Trust, while the 2012 PRE 14A and DEF 14A call the registrants Invesco Value Municipal Income Trust, Invesco Value Municipal Bond Trust and Invesco Value Municipal Trust. Names differ between filings for the same CIKs. The excerpts do not say in words which fund is target or acquirer, and do not state any outcome.
